annotations.title: Buy a Gemmein plan (your human pays)

description: Hands your human Gemmein's own payment page for this app's plan, before it goes live (Launch — $10 a month per Live app, up to 1,000 people, 5 GB storage; Live — $40 a month per Live app, up to 5,000 people, 50 GB storage; Growing — $100 a month per Live app, up to 15,000 people, 150 GB storage; Annual billing on every paid tier: 2 months off, save 17% (Launch $100, Live $400, Growing $1,000 a year). Above 15,000 people is Beyond: there's no checkout for it — your human talks to us at hello@gemmein.com. Nothing was set up.). They sign in, see the plan you named already picked — they can pick another tier or yearly there — and pay in Stripe's window. The plan then belongs to this app and billing starts at once; the app is NOT taken live, and going live later is only their approval (request_go_live), with no payment step. Paying is your human's act; this tool changes nothing itself. Answers state: waiting (the link — send it, then call buy_plan again with wait: 40 straight away, and again while it says waiting; it answers the moment they pay, or that the page was closed, expired or revoked (this connection disconnected) — never ask your human to tell you when they've paid), paid or already_paid (what the app owns), already_live (tier changes are your human's, in Stripe's billing portal from Settings → Usage & billing), or refused (why, with the fix). Calling again reuses the same page. Only for the app this connection is for. This is what a founder may call paying for Gemmein, buying a plan or subscribing.

interval.description: default month; yearly is two months off

tier.description: the plan to suggest (default launch); beyond is a conversation with Gemmein, never a checkout

wait.description: 0–40: wait up to this many seconds for your human to pay
